### About

This site compiles maps and analysis for the New South Wales Summer Hill electoral district based on open source data. 

Check out the following links for more information:

* [Geography](geography.qmd) to learn about the statistical geographies used in this site.

* [Demographics](demographics.qmd) to learn more about the demographic make up of Summer Hill.

* [Data Sources](datasources.qmd) to see the open source data assets used in this site.
